court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: Management of Tamilnadu State Transport Corporation (Thirunelveli) Ltd., Rep. by its General Manager Nagercoil
advocates: For Respondent: Mr. P.F. Ferlin Castro Standing Counsel
prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a writ of mandamus directing the respondent to pay the petitioner interest at the rate of 18% per annum for the period of delay from 1-7-2025 to 10-3-2026 in paying the amounts paid towards his terminal benefits, namely, EPF Employee's contribution, gratuity and encashment of leaves within a time frame as may be fixed by this Court and without affecting his right to claim balance amounts towards those benefits.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Mummineni Sudheer Kumar, J.:— Mr P.F. Ferlin Castro, learned Standing Counsel, takes notice for the respondent - Transport Corporation.

2. With the consent of both sides, this writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondent - Transport Corporation.

4. The learned counsel on either side unanimously agree that the issue involved in this writ petition is squarely covered by various Judgments passed by the Division Bench of this Court in W.A.(MD) No. 403 of 2010 and batch, dated 15-6-2014 and W.A.(MD) No. 1419 of 2021 and batch, dated 26-7-2021.

5. In the said circumstances, this writ petition is allowed and the respondent is directed to pay interest at the rate of 6% per annum for the belated payment of the petitioner's terminal benefits, namely, EPF Employee's contribution, gratuity and encashment of leaves, from the date of his retirement till the date on which those benefits are paid to the petitioner. The respondent is further directed to comply with the said direction as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of five months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. No costs.
